summary: 51-year-old man from Baton Rouge, LA, reported overdue on a hike in the Mount Chapin/Mount Chiquita/Ypsilon area; not heard from since Monday morning 07/01. RMNP SAR ground teams searched the Chapin, Chiquita, Ypsilon, Chapin Creek and Poudre River trail areas with Northern Colorado Interagency Helitack aerial reconnaissance; found ~1:30 p.m. Wednesday at 11,400 ft on the NW side of Mount Chapin, uninjured but exhausted after two unplanned backcountry nights; flown out by Helitack ~3 p.m., ambulance to Estes Park Health.
responding_agency: Rocky Mountain National Park Search and Rescue; Northern Colorado Interagency Helitack
notes: Date = found/search-conclusion date 07/03 (Wednesday, NPS release date; notified 07/02, missing since 07/01). Rental car at Alpine Visitor Center lot.
